summary: This Form 6-K filed by Austin Gold Corp. is a routine report of the results of its 2026 annual general meeting held on May 6, 2026. The filing includes standard matters such as the election of directors (five directors re-elected with over 99% support), setting the number of directors at five, and appointing Manning Elliott LLP as auditors. With 52.38% of shares represented, this is a routine governance event. No special situation, transaction, or corporate action is disclosed. As a foreign private issuer's periodic report of a shareholder meeting, it equates to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07 but with no material definitive agreement or unusual event.
